name: Muhamed Anees K Mousafi
hook: From technical talks to leading the whole club
challenge: He was comfortable in technical and business discussions, yet not always sure his words were landing the way he intended.
transformation: Today he serves as President of Talk-Masters and leads the club with confidence, speaking to audiences with clarity and purpose.

journey.text: Joined Talk-Masters in 2024, looking for a space to step out of his comfort zone and find his voice.
Served as Sergeant at Arms in 2025–26: his first taste of club leadership.
Entrusted with the role of Club President for 2026–27.
Part of the team that helped Talk-Masters win the Smedley Award in two consecutive years and achieve 6 Distinguished Club Program goals.

impact.career: Toastmasters is helping me present my ideas clearly and engage confidently with clients, partners, and senior stakeholders.
impact.confidence: I have moved from hesitating to speak in public to leading meetings and addressing audiences with confidence.
impact.leadership: I strongly believe in out-of-the-box thinking, strategic planning, and disciplined implementation. Serving as Sergeant at Arms and now as Club President has given me the opportunity to put these beliefs into practice. Contributing to the club’s Smedley Award wins and DCP success showed me what a committed team can achieve when ideas are backed by a clear plan and consistent action.

advice: You already have the knowledge. Toastmasters helps you find the confidence to share it.
adviceShort: You already have the knowledge. Toastmasters helps you find the confidence to share it.
story: Anees joined Talk-Masters in 2024 to step out of his comfort zone. What began as a way to build confidence grew into a passion for leading others, and today, as Club President, he enjoys guiding and supporting fellow members on their own journeys.
contribution: Out-of-the-box thinking, strategic planning and disciplined follow-through: ideas backed by a clear plan and consistent action.

name: Hadi Abdulkader
headline: Mechanical engineer, now a public speaking trainer
challenge: As a mechanical engineer, he was confident in his technical knowledge but struggled to communicate his ideas with the same confidence. Knowing something and communicating it well, he realised, were two very different skills.
transformation: Today communication is his profession: a public speaking and workplace communication trainer who helps professionals build the skills he once struggled to build himself.

journey.text: Joined Toastmasters in 2016 with a simple goal: to become a better speaker.
Kept showing up through hesitant moments, disappointing performances and hard feedback, and found that confidence comes through practice, not before it.
Won at Division level in the Humorous Speech, International Speech and Table Topics contests.
Moved from mechanical engineering into public speaking and workplace communication training, now as Director – Trainings at Public Speaking Gym.
Invited as the Featured Speaker for Talk-Masters' 100th meeting, "Century of Voice".

impact.career: My Toastmasters journey helped me discover my passion for training and gradually transition from mechanical engineering into public speaking and workplace communication training.
impact.confidence: From hesitating to express my ideas, I have grown into someone who can address audiences, facilitate workshops, and share lessons through videos in English and Malayalam.
impact.leadership: Taking on club responsibilities, supporting fellow members, and facilitating learning experiences have helped me develop the ability to guide, encourage, and bring out the best in others.

advice: Don’t wait to become confident before you start speaking. Start speaking, and confidence will follow. Just like a gym, every small practice makes you stronger.
adviceShort: Start speaking, and confidence will follow.
story: “I joined Toastmasters to find my voice. Along the way, I discovered my purpose: helping others find theirs.” For Hadi, the club is still his practice ground: every speech he gives and every evaluation he receives is a reminder that there is always room to improve.
contribution: A trainer's eye for turning ideas into messages that connect: structuring a speech, strengthening an opening, using a purposeful pause, making a message memorable. And still a learner, taking something new from every meeting.

name: Prathiba Leo
headline: TEDx speaker and communication coach at TiE Dubai
hook: A TEDx Speaker, a Communication Coach — and Still a Student of the Stage
challenge: Already a TEDx speaker and an active public speaker, Prathiba was looking for a place to keep sharpening the craft, try different formats and learn among people who enjoy communication.
transformation: Today Talk-Masters is where Prathiba practises what a communication coach preaches: speaking, evaluating, moderating and hosting, within a network that keeps growing.

journey.text: Began her Toastmasters journey in India in 2020, then took a pause after moving to Dubai.
Spoke at TEDxChennaiInstituteOfTechnology, invited under the theme of empowered women.
Came to Talk-Masters in 2025 as a guest speaker for CareerNova, delivering a masterclass on “Selling Yourself”, and decided to join within two minutes.
Served as Club Treasurer, and took up roles such as Evaluator and Toastmaster of the Day.
Moderated the panel discussion at She Leads – Where Every Woman Is a Leader, in September 2025: a conversation people still talk about.
Moderated the “Real Transformers” panel at Talk-Masters' 100th meeting.
Conducts masterclasses, visits other clubs across Dubai, and is working towards completing a first path, Visionary Communication.

impact.career: Toastmasters gives me a consistent space to practise the skills at the centre of my professional life: public speaking, moderation, facilitation, storytelling and leadership communication. It has also strengthened my visibility and credibility as a communication coach and public speaker.
impact.confidence: For me, confidence was never simply about being able to stand on a stage. Toastmasters has helped me become a more versatile and intentional communicator. Whether I am delivering a prepared speech, evaluating someone, moderating a panel, taking up an impromptu role or addressing a completely new audience, every experience stretches a slightly different communication muscle.
impact.leadership: Serving as Treasurer and taking up different club responsibilities has let me experience leadership beyond my professional role. It has taught me to contribute to a community, support other speakers, give constructive feedback, coordinate with people and, sometimes, simply step up when something needs to be done.
impact.networking: I have found an incredible network of people from completely different professions, industries and walks of life. It keeps widening every time I attend a meeting, visit another club or take part in an event, and it has exposed me to perspectives and conversations I might otherwise never have encountered.

advice: Just come in and immerse yourself in the experience. You don’t need to know exactly what Toastmasters is, or wonder whether you are “good enough” to be there. Observe, participate, speak to people and experience the room. Sometimes, as it did for me, it might take just two minutes to realise you have found your people.
adviceShort: It might take just two minutes to realise you have found your people.
story: Prathiba first walked into Talk-Masters in 2025 as a guest speaker, delivering a masterclass on “Selling Yourself” at CareerNova. It took two minutes to decide to join. “There was something almost enigmatic about the vibe of Talk-Masters: the energy, the warmth and, most importantly, the people.” Since then, the club has become family, and a reminder that no matter how much you speak professionally, there is always something new to learn, practise and improve.
contribution: A TEDx speaker's craft and a professional moderator's gift for drawing people out, shared through masterclasses, panels and meeting roles.

name: Tarannum Sheikh
headline: Educator and founder of Active Kids, TEDx speaker
challenge: An educator for nearly a decade across India and the UAE, she wanted children to build the confidence that years on stage had given her.
transformation: Today she runs Active Kids, an online academy where she and her team teach children public speaking and life skills, and she speaks on the TEDx stage herself.

journey.text: Started as a Toastmaster at another club, and has spent more than nine years in Toastmasters, with over 100 speeches.
Founded Active Kids in May 2020, a virtual academy for children's skill development.
Created Speak & Shine, live public speaking and debate classes for children aged 5 to 14.
Joined Talk-Masters recently, bringing years of experience to a new room.

impact.career: Turned public speaking into an academy that has taught hundreds of children.
impact.leadership: Leads the Active Kids team of trainers.
impact.confidence: Shares her story on the TEDx stage and in her writing as an author.

advice: Start small: one minute on your feet is a beginning.
adviceShort: Start small: one minute on your feet is a beginning.
story: After more than nine years in Toastmasters, Tarannum still treats every meeting as practice. She brings that habit to Talk-Masters, and the same message to the children she teaches: start small, and keep showing up.
contribution: Nearly a decade of Toastmasters experience and more than 100 speeches, shared generously with newer members.

name: Suhayb Muzammil Shaik
occupation: Final-year cybersecurity student and Head of the Cyber Team
headline: Never on a stage before 2024, now a club contest winner
challenge: Before joining Talk-Masters in 2024, Suhayb had never spoken on stage. He was comfortable behind a screen with complex technical detail, but speaking to an audience with clarity felt intimidating. What changed everything was the people: from his earliest meetings, members encouraged him and gave him honest feedback.
transformation: Today he steps onto the stage to deliver speeches, evaluate fellow members and take on meeting roles with confidence.

journey.text: Joined Talk-Masters in 2024.
Has taken on nearly every meeting role except Toastmaster of the Day, including Speaker, Evaluator and Timer.
Won first place in the club’s Humorous Speech contest with “Recalculating”, then represented Talk-Masters at the Area-level contest.
Joined the Executive Committee for 2026–27.

impact.confidence: Toastmasters helped me turn nervousness into structure, hesitation into storytelling, and fear into a genuine enjoyment of public speaking.
impact.leadership: Each role taught me a different side of communication: how to speak with purpose, listen actively, give constructive feedback, and support the flow of a meeting.
impact.career: My bigger ambition is to become a tech founder. I am working on INTAKE, an AI-powered platform that makes university admissions easier for students. A strong idea only creates impact when you can pitch it clearly, inspire others, and lead with confidence.

advice: Don’t wait to become confident. Show up, speak, and become it.
adviceShort: Don’t wait to become confident. Show up, speak, and become it.
story: His humorous speech “Recalculating” won first place at the club contest and took Suhayb to the Area-level contest. He didn’t win there, but it taught him something more valuable than a trophy: every stage is practice, and every setback is part of recalculating your path forward.
contribution: Posters, campaigns and creative ideas that put the club in front of new people, including leading the creation of this website so guests can find Talk-Masters more easily.
hook: From never on a stage to first place with “Recalculating”

name: Jassim Eranhole
organisation: IKEA (United Arab Emirates, Qatar, Egypt and Oman)
headline: Digital content (UX/UI) specialist at IKEA
hook: A 100-day video challenge, and a promise to the club
challenge: Jassim had ideas and knowledge to share, but found it hard to put them into words with confidence at work.
transformation: Today Jassim speaks up in meetings, shares ideas and presents with more confidence, and colleagues at work have noticed the change.

journey.text: Spent more than 15 years in design and digital for retail brands: FedEx Office, Debenhams and IKEA in Kuwait, then Alghanim Industries' Xcite.com, before joining IKEA in Dubai in 2022.
Joined Talk-Masters in June 2024.
Started WhatsApp groups so members could practise speaking between meetings and keep each other going.
Completed a 100-day daily video challenge: a lesson in showing up, even when not fully happy with the performance.
Served as Toastmaster of the Day for Meeting #101.
Colleagues began to notice the progress and encouraged more presentations at work.

impact.career: I can explain my design ideas more clearly, contribute to discussions, and share my knowledge with colleagues more confidently.
impact.leadership: Taking meeting roles and encouraging others through practice groups have helped me take responsibility and support other people’s growth.
impact.confidence: I have become more willing to speak, ask questions, and try. I am learning to share my thoughts without waiting for perfect English.

advice: Come as you are. You do not need perfect English or confidence to begin. Keep attending, ask for help, and practise between meetings. The club supports you, and your daily effort helps you grow.
adviceShort: You do not need perfect English or confidence to begin.
story: Jassim joined Toastmasters to communicate better and grow at work. At first, speaking was not easy: there were worries about English, about explaining thoughts clearly and about how people would respond. So Jassim asked for guidance, listened to feedback and learned from other speakers, and kept working between meetings with books, tongue twisters, voice exercises, daily videos and WhatsApp practice groups. Some days brought progress; on others, even a simple thought was hard to explain. The practice continued, along with one promise to the club: “Whenever I am in Dubai, I will be there at Toastmasters.”
contribution: WhatsApp practice groups that keep members speaking between meetings, and the steady example of a 100-day daily video challenge.

name: Nabeel Bava
hook: From nervous around senior leaders to speaking up in any room
challenge: He lacked confidence when speaking to people in positions of power or authority, such as managers and senior officials.
transformation: Today he speaks to audiences, addresses groups of colleagues, and expresses his thoughts with much greater confidence and without fear.

journey.text: First joined Talk-Masters in 2021.
Returned to Toastmasters in 2026, after a pause, to keep working on himself.
Became the club's Treasurer for 2026–27, taking on responsibilities beyond public speaking.
Served as Toastmaster of the Day for Meeting #105, after taking on roles such as Timer and Grammarian.
Developing his speaking through speeches, including "Every Car Tells a Story".

impact.career: Toastmasters is helping me communicate more effectively, express ideas clearly, and engage confidently with people at all levels of the organisation.
impact.confidence: I have moved from feeling intimidated when speaking to senior people to expressing my thoughts more confidently in front of groups, colleagues, and audiences.
impact.leadership: Serving as Club Treasurer and taking on meeting roles have helped me develop responsibility, coordination, and leadership skills while contributing to the club’s success.

advice: Don’t wait for confidence before you begin. Take the first step, keep showing up, and let confidence grow through experience.
adviceShort: Take the first step, keep showing up, and let confidence grow through experience.
story: For Nabeel, Toastmasters is not just about delivering speeches. It is about building confidence, expressing his thoughts freely, and growing as a person and a professional. He first joined in 2021, came back in 2026, and now serves as the club's Treasurer.
contribution: A steady hand on the club's finances as Treasurer, and a member who says yes to meeting roles, from Timer and Grammarian to Toastmaster of the Day.

name: Noufal Aboobacker
hook: Guest in 2020, member in 2025, now running meetings
challenge: Fear and a lack of confidence held Noufal back when speaking in front of people, and turning thoughts from Malayalam into English quickly made it harder still.
transformation: Today Noufal conducts meetings, coordinates role players, and serves as the club's Sergeant at Arms.

journey.text: First attended Talk-Masters as a guest in 2020.
Joined the club in August 2025, with a simple goal: to improve English and become more confident.
Took on Table Topics Master, Zoom Master of the Day and Sergeant at Arms, and served as Toastmaster of the Day for Meeting #106.
Now serving as the club's Sergeant at Arms for 2026–27.
Working through Level 2 speeches in the Dynamic Leadership path.

impact.career: As an IT professional, I have technical knowledge and experience, but I realised that technical skills alone are not enough to grow in a career. We also need to communicate our ideas clearly, share our opinions confidently, and explain technical problems to different people.
impact.confidence: Today, I may still feel nervous, and I may still make mistakes, but I no longer see them as reasons to stop speaking.
impact.leadership: By taking on roles such as Table Topics Master, Toastmaster of the Day, Zoom Master of the Day, and Sergeant at Arms, I am getting opportunities to take responsibility, coordinate with people, listen to different opinions, and help meetings run smoothly.

advice: Please don’t make the same mistake I made by waiting for years before joining Talk-Masters. Don’t wait for the perfect moment. Take the first step today. Come, join us, participate in the activities, take up roles, and experience the energy, positivity, and encouragement this club offers.
adviceShort: Don’t wait for the perfect moment. Take the first step today.
story: Noufal first came to Talk-Masters as a guest in 2020, but only joined in 2025. "Instead of focusing on the five years I missed, I am grateful that I finally took that first step." The energy, encouragement and support of fellow members are helping Noufal grow more confident at work and at home, and discover that the club is not just a place to improve speaking skills, but a place to find one's potential.
contribution: A steady presence who sets the room for every meeting as Sergeant at Arms, and says yes to roles, from Zoom Master to Toastmaster of the Day.

name: Edwin Sunny
headline: Sales engineer, now Sales Director at H2O Hospitality
hook: From backbencher to Sales Director, one meeting at a time
challenge: A self-described backbencher at school and college, Edwin started out in Dubai as a Sales Engineer, caught between demanding clients and sales targets, while colleagues who spoke up in meetings took the credit for his hard work.
transformation: Today he is Sales Director at H2O Hospitality, closing deals and leading meetings with the voice he once kept to himself.

journey.text: Came to his first Talk-Masters meeting in 2018 at a friend's invitation, and paid his membership fee on the spot.
Took on his first club role as Vice President Membership.
Rose from Sales Engineer to Assistant Manager, Manager and Senior Manager over 13 years at Samsotech, earning a promotion every two years.
Became Sales Director at H2O Hospitality, leading the delivery of hospitality software such as online check-in and CRM systems.
Serves the club today as its Immediate Past President.

impact.career: The professional results were immediate. I began closing deals with confidence, leading internal management meetings and changing how people in the company saw me. Over 13 years at Samsotech, I earned a promotion every two years, rising from Sales Engineer to Senior Manager and, in the end, overtaking my own seniors.
impact.confidence: Talk-Masters gave me a warm, empowering environment that taught me to think on my feet, organise my thoughts and speak with impact. For someone who grew up on the back bench, it was a true transformation.

advice: Public speaking training is a powerful catalyst for professional growth, so visit our club at least once. You’ll find an inclusive, high-energy room that welcomes everyone, whatever your current skill level. Join us, sharpen your speaking skills and test your mettle in front of a larger audience.
adviceShort: Public speaking training is a powerful catalyst for professional growth.
story: Edwin landed in Dubai with great hopes and high ambitions, in a city of glittering skyscrapers. In 2018 a friend invited him to Talk-Masters. Inspired by Richard Branson's advice to say yes to great opportunities and work out the details later, he paid his membership fee that same day. “It was a journey of true human transformation.”
contribution: Eight years of club experience, from his first role as Vice President Membership to Immediate Past President, and living proof of what one “yes” can change.

name: Afnas Pareed
hook: From nervous before a crowd to sharing his ideas with confidence
challenge: Afnas lacked confidence speaking in front of a crowd and found it difficult to express his thoughts clearly.
transformation: Today he is more comfortable speaking to an audience and shares his ideas with confidence.

journey.text: Began his Toastmasters journey at CareerNova on 29 June 2025, and joined Talk-Masters.
Started speaking in front of a crowd: a meaningful milestone in itself.
Continues to develop his communication skills at Talk-Masters, alongside his work as a co-founder.

impact.career: Toastmasters is helping me communicate my ideas more clearly with clients, colleagues and business partners.
impact.confidence: I’m becoming more comfortable speaking in front of a crowd and expressing my thoughts.
impact.leadership: Toastmasters is helping me take the initiative and communicate with greater confidence in my role as a co-founder.

advice: Don’t wait until you feel confident. Take the first step, keep practising and let your confidence grow with experience.
adviceShort: Don’t wait until you feel confident.
story: Afnas’s Toastmasters journey began at CareerNova on 29 June 2025, where he found his way to Talk-Masters. He has made meaningful progress in a short time: the club has given him a supportive place to practise, learn from feedback and grow as a speaker.

name: Mohamed Rilwan
organisation: Jereh Oil Field Services Middle East FZE
hook: Small steps, stronger habits: growing one speech at a time
challenge: Rilwan wanted to improve his public speaking and express his ideas with greater confidence. His challenge was turning that intention into consistent practice.
transformation: Today he sees improvement as the result of small, repeated actions: preparing a speech, practising aloud, accepting feedback and trying again.

journey.text: Joined Talk-Masters in 2022 to strengthen his communication skills, and it gradually became a hobby.
Served on an evaluation panel, a reminder that listening carefully and giving thoughtful feedback are habits worth building alongside speaking.
Took on the role of Toastmaster of the Day for the “Atomic Habits” meeting, celebrating how small, consistent actions lead to meaningful growth.

impact.career: Practising clear communication supports the conversations that matter in my profession: supplier negotiations, team discussions and presentations.
impact.confidence: My focus is shifting from delivering a perfect speech to making steady progress, one speaking opportunity at a time.
impact.leadership: Leadership grows through daily habits: listening before responding, preparing well and following through on commitments.

advice: Start small. Introduce yourself, volunteer for a short role or try a Table Topic. You don’t need confidence before you begin; you can build it through practice.
adviceShort: You don’t need confidence before you begin; you can build it through practice.
story: Rilwan joined Toastmasters to strengthen his communication skills, and it gradually became a hobby. The theme “Atomic Habits” matches his approach to learning: every chance to speak is another chance to improve. As Toastmaster of the Day, he set out to help members recognise the small habits that shape their progress.
contribution: Careful listening and thoughtful feedback, from the evaluation panel to leading a meeting as Toastmaster of the Day.

name: Lulu Baseerath
occupation: Manager – Business Development, logistics and supply chain
hook: One year, one decision, countless possibilities
challenge: Lulu was always confident, persuasive and quick to take the initiative, but the bigger dream was to become a professional trainer, and that called for the public speaking skills to engage an audience, handle questions with confidence and learn from experienced speakers and leaders.
transformation: Within a single year, Lulu has become Vice President Membership and Assistant Area Program Quality Director, and is growing as a corporate trainer, content creator and leader.

journey.text: Started teaching tuition at 12; by 15, while in 10th grade, had around 20 students and was earning AED 4,500 a month.
Entered the corporate world at 17, explored entrepreneurship, and began investing in real estate plots and buildings at 22.
Joined Talk-Masters in September 2025, with the dream of becoming a professional trainer.
Became Vice President Membership for 2026–27, and Assistant Area Program Quality Director at the Area level.
Began creating social media videos, and took business development to international markets, travelling across the GCC, Europe, Turkey and China.

impact.career: Talk-Masters has broadened my perspective on business development. It is not just about selling services; it is about building global connections, developing meaningful customer relationships and creating long-term opportunities. It has encouraged me to think beyond geographical boundaries and connect with customers and business leaders across cultures. Today, I see business not just as transactions, but as relationships, connections and opportunities without borders.
impact.confidence: Talk-Masters has transformed my confidence into action and my ambition into reality. It has strengthened my communication skills, given me the confidence to pursue my dream of becoming a corporate trainer, and encouraged me to create social media videos. I joined with a dream to become a trainer; today, I am growing as a speaker, content creator and leader.
impact.leadership: Talk-Masters has taught me that leadership is not about holding a position; it is about taking responsibility, supporting others, creating opportunities and helping people grow. It has strengthened my ability to lead with empathy, encourage participation, build connections and bring people together towards a common goal.
impact.networking: Talk-Masters has broadened my vision beyond geographical boundaries. Today, I see the world not just as a place to travel, but as a world of connections, partnerships and business opportunities.

advice: Whatever your dream, ambition or goal may be, Talk-Masters can be the place where it begins. Here, you meet people from different backgrounds, with diverse ideas, perspectives, experiences and leadership styles, and every interaction is a chance to learn something new. Whatever brought you here, you can find the inspiration, guidance and right environment to plant the seeds of your dream and take your first steps towards it. Don’t just come with a dream. Come ready to give your dream a beginning!
adviceShort: Don’t just come with a dream. Come ready to give your dream a beginning!
story: Lulu’s story has always been about dreaming big and taking the wheel: “No excuses. No waiting. No blaming.” Teaching tuition at 12, entering the corporate world at 17 and investing in property at 22 built an entrepreneur’s mindset and the courage to take calculated risks. Talk-Masters came next, not just to find a voice, but to inspire others, transform lives and grow through that transformation. “One year, one decision, countless possibilities. The right platform can transform not just who you are, but who you can become.”
contribution: A family-like welcome for every guest and member, in the spirit Lulu sums up as “We don’t grow alone; we grow together”: every member’s success becomes everyone’s happiness, and every challenge becomes a chance to support one another.
